per_key_checks.assessment: Exact structural parallel to the existing zh-CN ui.common.actions.file_actions_menu.file_actions = '文件操作' for the sibling English 'File actions', and 图片 is the settled word for image in the same namespace (ui.chat.image_actions.copy_image = '复制图片', expand_image = '展开图片'). Short noun phrase, sentence case, no plural needed in Chinese, no trailing punctuation. Carries the context note's meaning (generic overflow-menu label and unnamed-asset accessible-name fallback) without adding a 菜单/action verb the English does not have. No placeholder in either side.

{label} byte-exact, still first, still a plain non-ICU argument; no plural branch needed and none added. The 的 attributive construction takes ANY inserted title without case, gender or number agreement, and Chinese inserts no space before the 的, so a Latin or CJK label both read correctly. 播放位置 is not an invented addition: it is the existing zh-CN rendering of this very concept (ui.chat.attachments.playback_position = '播放位置'), and bare 位置 would be ambiguous for an audio seek slider. Names the slider, not an action; distinct from the verb-first ui.chat.audio.play_label = '播放{label}' / pause_label = '暂停{label}' in the same namespace, so no collision with the play/pause controls.

Exact parallel to the two existing siblings in the same namespace: pasted_file = '粘贴的文件' and pasted_type = '粘贴的{mimeType}'. Short noun phrase, no extension, no MIME identifier and no placeholder, as the context note requires; functions as a fallback filename and as the attachment caption. No maxCells hint in the sidecar; 10 cells / 5 characters, comfortably short, no truncation risk.

{name} byte-exact and untouched. This is the SAME string the catalogue already carries for the identical English 'Actions for {name}' in two places: ui.chat.canonical.link_toolkit.actions_for = '{name}的操作' and ui.projects.project_board.actions_for_displayname = '{displayName}的操作'; ui.projects.project_updates.file_actions_for_name = '{name}的文件操作' also matches. Divergence here would have contradicted those. The 的 construction is grammatical for arbitrary user names (Latin, CJK, names ending in punctuation or quotes) with no agreement, and it reads as identification of the asset, not as a command on the name - which is exactly what the context note demands. Unquoted, matching the two file/asset peers; ui.browser.browser_tab_strip.actions_for = '“{title}”的操作' quotes because a tab title is arbitrary prose, a different asset class.

english_metadata_check.detail: Every clause is supported by the code, read but not executed. 'non-image data URIs': getFileName tests path.startsWith('data:image/') first and only the later path.startsWith('data:') branch returns pasted_file, so images never reach it. 'with no usable name, including invalid percent encoding': the nameMatch[1] branch is guarded by try/decodeURIComponent with catch returning pasted_file. 'whether or not a MIME type is present': the branch keys on the 'data:' prefix alone, so data:;base64,… and data:application/pdf;base64,… both land there. 'Also used as synthetic upload metadata': attachment-encode.ts takes const name = getFileName(attachment) and passes it as AttachmentUploadSource.name for a dataUrl, then files.push({name: stored.name ?? name}). 'valid names and attachment bytes stay unchanged': a decodable name is returned verbatim and 'the original dataUrl (and therefore its bytes/MIME) is passed untouched'. No clause overstates or understates the code.

observations_not_findings.detail: image-actions-menu.tsx:364 guards the shared key with `label != null` while supplement-file-actions.tsx:181 guards the same key with truthiness (`label ?`). Callers pass label={alt} (markdown-image.tsx:90), label={document.title} and label={row.name}, so an empty-string label (e.g. a markdown image with empty alt text) would satisfy `!= null` and yield t('ui.common.actions.actions_for_name',{name:''}), rendering '的操作' — with a leading 的. The ENGLISH degrades identically there ('Actions for '), so this is a source-side guard bug, locale-agnostic, not attributable to the zh-CN translation and not counted as a finding. Not proven by execution: read-only remit, no test covers label/alt (scripts/image-actions.test.mjs has no label/alt case). Flagged to the manager as a possible follow-up outside this audit.

The English 'Actions for {name}' now exists under two keys: the legacy ui.chat.canonical.link_toolkit.actions_for and the new ui.common.actions.actions_for_name. check-duplicates passes (keys differ), and both zh-CN values are identical today ('{name}的操作'), so there is no current defect. Recorded only as a future drift risk for whoever owns the keying change.
